main_text.p: Evangelia Matthæi, Marci, Lucæ, Johannis esse divina & canonica.

De conclusionibus varia habet P. Harscher, de iis autem quia quærit & edoceri cupit recte facit, licet iam societatis Jesu Theologus, nam optime Ambrosius, erubescat senectus quæ emendare se non poterit. Deducam ergo ipsum ad Doctores quorum doctrinam & institutionem non poterit reiicere, nempe ex Apostolis, Patribus & Pontificiis præcipuos.
Quæret ergo P. Harscher, & Doctores respondebunt.

Harscher Jes. Vbi est scriptum Spiritum sanctum à Patre & Filio procedere? Bellarmine doce: Respondeo, ex scripturis ostenditur Spiritum sanctum à Filio procedere, Joh. 16: 15. Joh. 17: 10. Rom. 8: 9. Gal. 4: 6. Lombarde doce: Quod autem Filius ab utroque procedat multis divinorum eloquiorum testimoniis

page.notes: Printed text is slightly faded at the right edge; "Jesu" and "Harscher" read as printed. The line "Quæret" is printed "Quærat" in the scan; it is copied as printed. Bleed-through from the facing page is visible faintly and is omitted.
